record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: If X is a quartic threefold, are the stability conditions sigma(s,q,mu) constructed on its Kuznetsov component Serre-invariant for at least one choice of the parameters (s,q)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ be a smooth quartic hypersurface (a quartic threefold). Its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(X),\, \mathcal{O}_X,\, \mathcal{O}_X(1),\, \mathcal{O}_X(2),\, \mathcal{O}_X(3) \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is defined as the right orthogonal $\langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1), \mathcal{O}_X(2), \mathcal{O}_X(3) \rangle^{\perp}$. The Serre functor $S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)}$ of $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is an autoequivalence of this triangulated category.

Following the standard tilting construction, for real parameters $s \in \mathbb{R}$ and $q \in \mathbb{R}$ in an appropriate region, one considers a weak Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma(s,q)$ on $D^b(X)$ built from a double-tilt of the heart of coherent sheaves with respect to slope stability, together with a central charge depending on $(s,q)$. Choosing a further real parameter $\mu$, one then induces by tilting and restriction a Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma(s,q,\mu)$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$.

A Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is said to be Serre-invariant if there exists $\tilde{g} \in \widetilde{\mathrm{GL}}_2^{+}(\mathbb{R})$ such that $S_{\mathcal{K}u(X)} \cdot \sigma = \sigma \cdot \tilde{g}$.

Question: Does there exist at least one choice of admissible parameters $(s,q)$ (and a corresponding $\mu$) such that the induced stability condition $\sigma(s,q,\mu)$ on the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ of a smooth quartic threefold $X$ is Serre-invariant?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature establishes Serre-invariance of the constructed stability conditions on Kuznetsov components for cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, and Gushel–Mukai threefolds, and characterizes Serre-invariance via bounded homological dimension. However, the case of the (index-one) quartic threefold in $\mathbb{P}^4$ — whose Kuznetsov component is a Calabi–Yau category of higher dimension — does not appear to be settled in the search results found, and no source explicitly resolves Serre-invariance of $\sigma(s,q,\mu)$ for some $(s,q)$ in this case.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A stability condition σ on Ku(X) is Serre-invariant if and only if its homological dimension is at most 2; treated cases are cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, and GM threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: Results on Serre-invariance of stability conditions on Kuznetsov components are established for cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, and GM threefolds; the index-one quartic hypersurface case is not addressed in the available excerpts.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: All known stability conditions on Ku(X) for cubic X are Serre-invariant and lie in a single orbit.
status_evidence.claim: The Serre-invariance question is fully understood for cubic threefolds but not explicitly for quartic threefolds.
